The charge of $13.99 for Disney+ on October 7 was for your monthly subscription, which auto-renews. To stop future charges, you can cancel your subscription directly in your Disney+ account under "Account > Subscription > Cancel subscription."

If you'd still like to proceed with a refund for this charge, I can offer a prorated refund of $12.12, which reflects the unused days of your billing period. However, please note that refunding this charge will cancel your subscription, and you will lose access to Disney+. Would you like to go ahead with the refund?
Thanks, I'll cancel it there. Keep this month, I'll use it.
Got it! Enjoy your Disney+ subscription this month. If you need any further assistance, feel free to ask!
